milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The white wool blocks are placed at spawn-relative (3-4, 0-1, 1) as a 2x2 stack. Target is [4,1,1] (upper-right block). The player must navigate near the wool and face it to demonstrate they found it. max_distance=16 allows finding it from a reasonable distance, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Three yellow wall banners are placed at spawn-relative (7,2,4), (7,2,5), (7,2,6) on the west-facing wall of the trading post. Target is the middle banner at [7,2,5]. The player must approach and face the banners to demonstrate they found them. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the banners'.

Uses inventory_has because mining a pumpkin block drops a pumpkin item into the player's inventory. Four pumpkin blocks are placed at spawn-relative (5,0,3), (5,0,4), (5,0,5), (6,0,4). Mining any one of them adds a pumpkin to inventory. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because trading with the farmer villager (1 emerald → 6 bread) places bread into the player's inventory. The player starts with 10 emeralds and 0 bread, so any bread in inventory confirms a successful trade. This is the preferred rule type for trade/obtain tasks.
